title: Packing for a Camping Weekend
context: Molly 和 Jack 为营地过夜分工整理装备，并核对各自携带的东西。 本课属于 2026-11-22 预制系列，题目是原创口语练习，并非真实考试题。

dialogue.speaker: Molly
dialogue.en: I'm packing for our camping weekend. Do you have the tent?
dialogue.zh: 我正在为露营周末打包。帐篷在你那里吗？

dialogue.speaker: Jack
dialogue.en: Yes, and I checked that all the poles are in the bag.
dialogue.zh: 在，而且我检查过，所有支杆都在袋子里。

dialogue.speaker: Molly
dialogue.en: Great. I'll bring my sleeping bag and a small pillow.
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我会带睡袋和一个小枕头。

dialogue.speaker: Jack
dialogue.en: I'll pack mine too. Have you found your flashlight?
dialogue.zh: 我也会带上我的。你找到手电筒了吗？

dialogue.speaker: Molly
dialogue.en: Yes. I tested it and put spare batteries in my bag.
dialogue.zh: 找到了。我试过了，还把备用电池放进包里。

dialogue.speaker: Jack
dialogue.en: Good thinking. I'm bringing water bottles for both of us.
dialogue.zh: 想得周到。我会给我们两人带水瓶。

dialogue.speaker: Molly
dialogue.en: I'll pack a warm layer for the evening.
dialogue.zh: 我会为晚上带一件保暖外套。

dialogue.speaker: Jack
dialogue.en: I should bring one too. It may get cool after dark.
dialogue.zh: 我也该带一件。天黑后可能会变凉。

dialogue.speaker: Molly
dialogue.en: Do we need to bring towels?

dialogue.speaker: Jack
dialogue.en: The campsite message says to bring our own, so I'll pack one.
dialogue.zh: 营地发的消息说要自带，所以我会带一条。

dialogue.speaker: Molly
dialogue.en: I'll add mine to the list and check my bag tonight.
dialogue.zh: 我会把我的加到清单上，今晚检查背包。

dialogue.speaker: Jack
dialogue.en: Perfect. I'll put the tent by the door so we remember it.
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我会把帐篷放在门边，免得我们忘了带。

expressions.example: I keep spare batteries in a drawer.
Bring a warm layer for the evening.
The path is quiet after dark.
The invitation says to bring our own cups.
Add soap to the list, please.

pronunciation: camping 重读第一个音节；batteries 常读作两个或三个音节，重音在第一个音节。

practice.title: Part 1 · Packing
practice.prompt: Do you make a list before a trip?
practice.answer: Yes. A list helps me remember small things like a charger and a toothbrush.

practice.title: Part 2 · Preparing for a trip
practice.prompt: Describe a trip you prepared for. Say where you went, what you packed, and how you prepared.
practice.answer: Last fall I prepared for a weekend at a campsite with a friend. We shared a tent, so he checked the poles while I packed my sleeping bag and a flashlight. I also brought a warm layer and a towel after reading the campsite message. The night before we left, I checked my list once more. That made the morning less hurried and helped us start the trip in a good mood. 这是入门短答，请补充个人经历并扩展到接近两分钟。

practice.title: Part 3 · Planning trips
practice.prompt: Why do some people prefer to prepare carefully before traveling?
practice.answer: Preparation can reduce stress and help people remember things they need. However, leaving some free time in the plan can also make a trip feel more flexible.

practice.title: 跟读与口头练习
practice.prompt: 跟读后和同伴分工打包，说出三件物品并确认谁负责帐篷。
practice.answer: I'll bring my sleeping bag, a flashlight, and a towel. Do you have the tent? I'll check my list tonight.
